news.headline: H.C. Wainwright Raises Delcath Systems Price Target to $31 from $29, Reiterates Buy Rating
news.summary: Following Delcath's Q2 2026 beat-and-raise report, H.C. Wainwright reiterated a Buy rating and lifted its price target to $31 from $29, citing continued HEPZATO commercial momentum.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Highlights
news.summary: Delcath reported Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1 million (up from $24.2 million a year earlier) on roughly 30% HEPZATO volume growth, raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104-108 million, and ended the quarter with $95.9 million in cash and investments and no debt.

news.headline: BTIG Raises Delcath Systems Price Target to $21 from $17, Maintains Buy Rating
news.summary: BTIG Research lifted its price target on Delcath to $21 from $17 while keeping a Buy rating after the company's Q2 2026 earnings beat, which included EPS of $0.07 versus a forecast loss of $0.09 and revenue of $29.1 million.

news.headline: Delcath Systems to Participate at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Delcath announced its management team will present and hold investor meetings at the Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference in Boston, MA on Tuesday, August 11, 2026.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Delcath granted RSU inducement awards totaling 17,000 shares to four new employees who joined in May and June 2026, vesting over three years, as the company continues to build out its commercial and clinical teams.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 Clinical Trial of HEPZATO in Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: Delcath dosed the first patient at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in its global DELUMA Phase 2 trial testing HEPZATO plus standard of care versus standard of care alone in roughly 90 patients with liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer, across 20+ US/European sites.

catalysts.label: Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
catalysts.detail: Delcath management to present and hold investor meetings in Boston, MA.

catalysts.label: HEPZATO treatment center expansion
catalysts.detail: Company guidance points to roughly 37 active treatment centers by year-end 2026 (trimmed from an earlier target) with the 40-center mark now expected in Q1 2027.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results expected roughly three months after the August 6, 2026 Q2 report, based on prior reporting cadence; exact date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: DELUMA Phase 2 trial enrollment (metastatic breast cancer)
catalysts.detail: Global randomized ~90-patient trial of HEPZATO plus standard of care vs. standard of care alone in liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer; first patient dosed July 2026, with enrollment continuing across 20+ US/European sites.

catalysts.label: Pipeline/indication expansion beyond uveal melanoma
catalysts.detail: Continued clinical and commercial exploration of HEPZATO/CHEMOSAT in additional liver-dominant cancers (e.g., breast cancer, colorectal metastases) beyond the approved uveal melanoma indication.

pulse: Delcath enters mid-August 2026 on a strong footing after a clear beat-and-raise Q2 2026 (revenue $29.1M vs. $24.2M a year ago, EPS of $0.07 beating a forecast loss, guidance lifted to $104-108M, $95.9M cash with no debt), with sell-side sentiment staying firmly positive as H.C. Wainwright ($31 PT) and BTIG ($21 PT) both raised targets and reiterated Buy ratings this month. The stock has continued to climb since the print, trading in the mid-teens (around $14.75-$16.38 on August 9) as investors look ahead to management's appearance at the Canaccord Genuity Growth Conference on August 11. The DELUMA Phase 2 breast-cancer trial, which began dosing patients in July, remains the key pipeline extension beyond the approved uveal melanoma indication, while the main watch item is the pace of new HEPZATO treatment-center activations, trimmed to about 37 by year-end 2026 with the 40-center mark pushed into Q1 2027.
